# Victory Skating Academy

> Online figure skating academy. Live online off-ice group classes for double jumps, the Double Axel and triple jumps, plus private lessons booked through the VSA app. Also known as: Victory Skating, VSA, Victory Skating Academy, VSA World.

## Offerings

### 6-Month Double Jumps Club

Level 2 online off-ice group training for skaters moving to double jumps (double salchow, toe loop, loop, flip and lutz): two live 45-minute classes every Saturday and Sunday, 48 classes over 6 months, $299.

- Level: Level 2
- Price: 299.00 USD for 6 months
- Enroll / buy: https://buy.stripe.com/fZubJ16anape0P0eRhdMM1L
- Schedule: every Saturday and Sunday at 08:00 America/Los_Angeles time, 45 minutes (local times in any timezone are available through the MCP tools)
- Enrollment: open continuously; join any time and start at the next session
- Led by: Coach Diana, Coach Marta
- Source: https://victoryskating.com/doublejumps

### 6-Month Double Axel Club

Level 3 online off-ice group training for skaters who already land double jumps off-ice and want to master the Double Axel: two live 45-minute classes with Coach Marta every Saturday and Sunday, 48 classes over 6 months, $299.

- Level: Level 3
- Price: 299.00 USD every 6 months, renews automatically until cancelled, non-refundable
- Enroll / buy: https://buy.stripe.com/14AeVd6anbti69kcJ9dMM1M
- Schedule: every Saturday and Sunday at 07:00 America/Los_Angeles time, 45 minutes (local times in any timezone are available through the MCP tools)
- Enrollment: open continuously; join any time and start at the next session
- Led by: Coach Marta
- Source: https://victoryskating.com/doubleaxel

### 6-Month Triple Jumps Club

Level 4 online off-ice group training for skaters who are proficient in triple jumps off-ice and want to land them: two live 45-minute classes every Saturday and Sunday, 48 classes over 6 months, $299.

- Level: Level 4
- Price: 299.00 USD for 6 months
- Enroll / buy: https://buy.stripe.com/aFa8wP9mz54UbtEgZpdMM1t
- Schedule: every Saturday and Sunday at 07:00 America/Los_Angeles time, 45 minutes (local times in any timezone are available through the MCP tools)
- Enrollment: open continuously; join any time and start at the next session
- Led by: Coach Alice, Coach Lena
- Source: https://victoryskating.com/triplejumps

### Private lesson with Coach Marta

One-to-one online class with Coach Marta at $60 per hour, booked in the VSA app.

- Price: 60.00 USD per hour
- Enroll / buy: https://vsaworld.com/download/
- Led by: Coach Marta
- Source: https://victoryskating.com/doubleaxel
